name: SoMuch

sources.title: SoMuch - Enter Your Link Information (submit form)

conditions: Free submission enters a first-in-first-out content-review queue: 'could take anywhere from a few hours to a couple of weeks'
Email verification is required - 'Links won't show until verified by email you are sent and approved by SoMuch.com'
Right after submitting you are offered a paid upgrade 'for quicker approval or better placement'
requirements: Fields: domain/URL, site title/name, email address, Topic + Category (two-level picker), description (max 255 characters)
Description cap is tight: 255 characters max
preparation: Domain/URL, site title, and a <=255-character description
Email address you can access for the verification message
The right Topic -> Category pair from their picker (Business, Web Site Development, Internet, Computing, etc.)
workflow: Enter domain/URL, site title, email, pick Topic then Category, and write a <=255-char description
On the post-submit screen, either accept the paid upgrade for quicker approval/placement or continue free
Click the verification link in the confirmation email - the link won't appear until verified AND approved
A 'Delete your Link' page exists at /link-delete.asp for removal
watchFor: Two approval layers: email verification AND SoMuch.com approval - the email alone is not enough
Post-submit upsell for faster approval/placement - decline cleanly if staying free
Queue time is indeterminate (hours to weeks)
A Rakuten 'ebates' cashback promo is embedded on the page - ignore it
countsAsLive: The link is publicly visible in its chosen Topic/Category listing on somuch.com after email verification and approval
unknowns: What the paid upgrade costs (offered only after submission)
Whether the listing link is dofollow
Rejection criteria beyond the FIFO review
